task: Apply the extracted minimalist UI style to the user's webapp
priority: Preserve existing product logic unless explicitly asked to redesign flows
hard_constraints: Do not implement or imitate captcha, passkey, or security verification logic
Only borrow visual language from the reference recording
Keep accessibility: color contrast AA minimum, visible focus states, touch targets >= 44px
Support both mobile and desktop responsive layouts
Avoid adding decorative elements not present in the reference style

required: theme variables for light and dark

implementation_plan.name: Set design tokens
details: Create CSS variables or Tailwind theme extension from design_tokens.json
Use semantic tokens like --bg, --surface, --text-primary instead of hard-coded colors

implementation_plan.name: Refactor base layout
details: Use a narrow content column for settings/forms
Use grouped cards with 16px padding and 12-16px radius
Adopt muted borders and minimal shadows

implementation_plan.name: Standardize controls
details: Inputs/selects: clean outline, soft focus ring, 44px height

implementation_plan.name: Add theme system
details: Implement light and dark theme token maps
Persist theme choice in localStorage or server profile
Ensure identical spacing and structure across themes

implementation_plan.name: Icon and status polish
details: Use semantic colors only for status and destructive actions

buttons: primary button is visually prominent but not oversized
secondary button is neutral and bordered or subtle-filled
all buttons preserve shape across themes

apply: create reusable class recipes via @layer components or cva
component classes reference semantic vars only
keep business logic separate from style

prompt_template_for_ai_agent.system_style_instruction: Use the provided design tokens and component rules exactly. Rebuild the UI in a minimalist enterprise dashboard style with rounded cards, restrained icons, a single blue primary CTA, muted borders, and full light/dark theme parity. Do not emulate captcha, passkey, or security-specific flows. Focus only on visuals, spacing, theming, component consistency, and accessibility.
prompt_template_for_ai_agent.task_instruction: Transform the target webapp's existing components to match the spec. Output production-ready code, preserve current app logic, and annotate any place where the source app structure prevents exact visual parity.
